meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 它会从 channels 分支复制 Slack 适配器和格式化技能到项目里，注册适配器并安装依赖，然后构建、跑注册测试；接着引导你创建 Slack 应用、填入令牌并重启服务，之后就能在 Slack 频道和私信里收发消息。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加 Slack 频道集成时触发；在添加频道、填写 Slack 凭据（如 bot token、app token 等）和重启服务的过程中由它接管。

say.text: 帮我把 Slack 频道集成加到项目里
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并跑注册测试

say.text: 我用 Socket Mode 接 Slack，不要公网地址
say.note: 跳过 webhook，只存 xapp- 令牌

say.text: 重启服务，让 Slack 适配器生效
say.note: 运行 restart.sh 并等待 CLI socket

howto.what_en: It copies the Slack adapter and formatting skill from the channels branch, registers it, installs the pinned package, builds and runs the registration test, then walks you through Slack app tokens and a restart so channels and DMs work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Slack channel integration to NanoClaw; it takes over while adding the channel, collecting Slack credentials and restarting the service.

say_en.text: Add Slack channel integration to my project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, runs the test

say_en.text: Use Socket Mode for Slack, no public URL
say_en.note: Skips webhook, stores only the xapp- token

say_en.text: Restart the service so the Slack adapter loads
say_en.note: Runs restart.sh and waits for the CLI socket
